WITH scoped AS (
  SELECT ci.*,
    LOWER(SPLIT_PART(TRIM(ci.hostname), '.', 1)) AS dkey,
    CASE ci.source WHEN 'merged' THEN 0 WHEN 'ocs-only' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS src_rank
  FROM msp_cache.cache_inventario ci
  WHERE LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(workgroup, '\.local$', '', 'i')) = LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE('{{ String($("resolver_modulos").first().json.ocsGroup || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '\.local$', '', 'i'))
     OR (workgroup = 'unknown-eset' AND LOWER(eset_email) = LOWER('{{ String($("resolver_modulos").first().json.esetEmail || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}'))
),
eset_overlay AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (dkey) dkey,
    eset_uuid AS o_eset_uuid, eset_display_name AS o_eset_display_name,
    eset_last_seen AS o_eset_last_seen, eset_status AS o_eset_status,
    eset_threats AS o_eset_threats, eset_email AS o_eset_email, eset_products AS o_eset_products
  FROM scoped WHERE source = 'eset-only'
  ORDER BY dkey, eset_last_seen DESC NULLS LAST
),
primaria AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (dkey) * FROM scoped
  ORDER BY dkey, src_rank, (CASE WHEN hostname LIKE '%.%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), ocs_last_contact DESC NULLS LAST
)
SELECT
  p.inv_id, p.workgroup, p.hostname, p.mac, p.bios_serial, p.hardware_uuid,
  p.os, p.os_version, p.cpu, p.cpu_cores, p.cpu_speed_mhz, p.ram_mb,
  p.disk_gb, p.disk_type, p.ip, p.disk_used_pct, p.disk_health, p.disk_hours_on,
  p.ocs_id, p.ocs_last_contact, p.ocs_username, p.ocs_tag,
  COALESCE(p.eset_uuid, eo.o_eset_uuid) AS eset_uuid,
  COALESCE(p.eset_display_name, eo.o_eset_display_name) AS eset_display_name,
  COALESCE(p.eset_last_seen, eo.o_eset_last_seen) AS eset_last_seen,
  COALESCE(p.eset_status, eo.o_eset_status) AS eset_status,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(p.eset_threats, 0), eo.o_eset_threats, 0) AS eset_threats,
  COALESCE(p.eset_products, eo.o_eset_products) AS eset_products,
  COALESCE(p.eset_email, eo.o_eset_email) AS eset_email,
  p.last_kb_update, p.kb_count_30d, p.is_virtual, p.uptime_days,
  p.disks_json, p.memory_slots_json, p.networks_json, p.drives_json,
  CASE WHEN p.source = 'ocs-only' AND eo.o_eset_uuid IS NOT NULL THEN 'merged' ELSE p.source END AS source,
  CASE WHEN p.source = 'ocs-only' AND eo.o_eset_uuid IS NOT NULL THEN 'hostname' ELSE p.source_match END AS source_match,
  p.synced_at
FROM primaria p
LEFT JOIN eset_overlay eo ON eo.dkey = p.dkey
ORDER BY (CASE WHEN p.source = 'merged' THEN 0 WHEN p.source = 'ocs-only' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END), p.hostname ASC

SELECT cd.det_id, cd.inv_id, cd.eset_uuid, cd.category, cd.severity, cd.occur_time, ci.hostname, ci.eset_status, ci.eset_products, ci.eset_email, ci.eset_last_seen FROM msp_cache.cache_inventario_detecciones cd JOIN msp_cache.cache_inventario ci ON ci.inv_id = cd.inv_id WHERE LOWER(ci.eset_email) = LOWER('{{ String($("resolver_modulos").first().json.esetEmail || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}') AND cd.occur_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '35 days'

SELECT ct.*, COALESCE(vh.horas_fs,0) AS horas_fs, COALESCE(vh.fs_count,0) AS fs_count, (SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT fs.tipo_soporte) FILTER (WHERE fs.tipo_soporte IS NOT NULL)  FROM msp_cache.cache_entity_rel rel  JOIN msp_cache.cache_fs fs ON fs.fsid = rel.related_id  WHERE rel.entity_id = ct.ticketid AND rel.entity_module='HelpDesk' AND rel.related_module='ServiceContracts') AS tipos_soporte, (SELECT array_agg(fs.contract_no)  FROM msp_cache.cache_entity_rel rel  JOIN msp_cache.cache_fs fs ON fs.fsid = rel.related_id  WHERE rel.entity_id = ct.ticketid AND rel.entity_module='HelpDesk' AND rel.related_module='ServiceContracts') AS fs_numeros FROM msp_cache.cache_tickets ct LEFT JOIN msp_cache.v_ticket_horas_fs vh ON vh.ticketid = ct.ticketid WHERE ct.account_id = ANY(string_to_array(NULLIF(regexp_replace('{{ String($("resolver_modulos").first().json.vtigerId || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '\\s', '', 'g'), ''), ',')::bigint[]) AND ct.createdtime >= NOW() - INTERVAL '35 days' AND (ct.deleted = false OR ct.deleted IS NULL)
SELECT zh.* FROM msp_cache.cache_zabbix_hosts zh WHERE zh.group_id = {{ Number($("resolver_modulos").first().json.zabbixGroup) || 0 }}
SELECT zt.* FROM msp_cache.cache_zabbix_triggers zt WHERE zt.group_id = {{ Number($("resolver_modulos").first().json.zabbixGroup) || 0 }} AND zt.is_active = true

SELECT d.infra_backup FROM crm_cache.diagnosticos d WHERE d.nc = '{{ String($("resolver_modulos").first().json.nombreCorto || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AND d.borrador = false ORDER BY d.created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT display_name, description, severity, status, device_count, create_time FROM msp_cache.cache_eset_incidentes WHERE LOWER(eset_email) = LOWER('{{ String($("resolver_modulos").first().json.esetEmail || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}') AND status = 'INCIDENT_STATUS_OPEN' AND synced_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '25 hours' AND create_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '180 days' ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT
  (SELECT score_total FROM crm_cache.diagnosticos WHERE nc = '{{ String($('get_cliente').first().json.nombreCorto || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AND borrador = false ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS score_total,
  (SELECT nivel_riesgo FROM crm_cache.diagnosticos WHERE nc = '{{ String($('get_cliente').first().json.nombreCorto || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AND borrador = false ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS nivel_riesgo,
  (SELECT created_at FROM crm_cache.diagnosticos WHERE nc = '{{ String($('get_cliente').first().json.nombreCorto || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AND borrador = false ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS created_at
